warning: Mapping requirements, not claims every owner is absent. No runtime edits or gameplay verification.

groups.requirement: Exact source-owned acquisition quantities, sheets and ordinary room interactions; unknown weight stays unknown, not zero.
Map complete weapon properties, masteries, hand/ability eligibility and actual attacks through shared owners. Reuse verified range/Heavy work; no item-ID dispatch or support claim from seed fields.
Map AC, training, Strength/Stealth penalties and real don/doff. Reuse delivered timing; broader penalty consumers and content still require reconciliation.
Separate Arrow pieces from purchase lots and Quiver; refuse empty attacks, spend/recover exact counts once, preserve counters at checkpoints.

Resolve six complete pack lists and exact once-only expansion. Existing three pack seeds are partial reuse. Shell versus contents and actual storage must not duplicate gear or pretend bundle contents fit the Backpack.
Map actual capacity, contents and transfer units; retain unknown empty weights and full-versus-empty weight facts. Reuse bounded container owners rather than declaring all capacity absent.
Map extreme-cold protection and actual food/water consumption to environmental procedures; prose or nourish effects do not establish full source behavior.
Map placement, level-ground eligibility, first-entry-per-turn save, exact damage/condition duration and ten-minute recoverable contents. Reuse spatial trigger owner.

Map exact-copy consulted Book topic/accuracy and eligible skills, costume impersonation and crowbar leverage. Existing purpose-aware/context modifier hooks are reuse points, not generic support certification.
Rope needs legal unwilling targets, knots, bound-leg restraint, exact escape/burst checks and object/source cleanup.
Map Bonus Action ignition/hood controls, cumulative fuel, extinguish/rekindle, cone/radius light and Torch attack through actual room/combat hosts. Retained light_source fields are incomplete rules.

Keep three distinct uses: attack replacement dousing, placed burning ground with once-per-turn damage, and six cumulative hours of fuel. Map durations and same-turn ordering without guessing unknown target facts.
Healer’s Kit spends one of ten uses to stabilize only an eligible Unconscious zero-HP creature. Retain partial seed; map uses and actual targets, no free reset on equip/reload.
Holy Water replaces one Attack-action attack and consumes one flask; keep remaining attacks, sight/range, Dexterity DC and Fiend/Undead gate. Seed effect arrays do not certify support.
Map exact variant proficiency, declared tool ability/DC, PB plus applicable skill Advantage and actual Utilize task outcomes. Do not use a generic +PB check as every tool action.

Craft source lists are preserved, not executable recipes or item grants. Reconcile the official crafting procedures and result definitions later; absent result definitions remain dependencies, not reasons to expand this package pass.

Map class-owned focus permission, free hands, Material costs/consumption and Holy Symbol held/worn/borne forms. Staff is one exact copy with both Quarterstaff and focus roles; existing tool-only staff seeds do not provide the weapon role.
Resolve form/tool choices and grant exactly once. Monk/Soldier copy matches chosen proficiency; Bard instrument choice remains independent. Generic Holy Symbol seed must not silently force Amulet.

Reuse full Wizard candidate Spellcasting and spellbook procedures; preserve owner, actual recorded spells, page/weight facts, focus role, loss/replacement and copying. Ordinary Book is not a Spellbook.
